securityChange.title: Server-issued exact-action runtime approvals
securityChange.rootCause: Hosted Guard previously accepted caller-controlled approval booleans and did not maintain a consumable approval ledger.
securityChange.controlOutcome: Approval-required actions now require a server-issued token bound to workspace, project, authoritative environment, tool and canonical arguments, with database-backed expiry, revocation and single-use consumption.
securityChange.privacyOutcome: Authenticated approver identity remains in the protected ledger and audit trail; the signed bearer token omits the internal approver identifier.

focusedApprovalGate.command: NODE_ENV=test node --test tests/access-control.test.js tests/runtime-policy.test.js tests/control-plane.test.js tests/postgresql.test.js

detectionBenchmark.scope: Small internal synthetic English regression set; not independent or production-representative.

limitations: The automated gate used isolated local test persistence and did not connect to the production PostgreSQL service.
PostgreSQL migration portability and row-lock SQL were inspected and tested through the adapter contract; live concurrent production behaviour is not yet verified.
No Render deployment, live migration application, live browser journey, real payment or production email was performed in this environment.
Internal engineering validation is not independent penetration testing, accredited certification or a guarantee that the system is risk-free.
liveVerificationRequired: Apply migration 008 through the normal deployment migration process and verify its checksum record.
Verify /api/ready reports version 9.2.0, production stage and a healthy PostgreSQL adapter.
Issue an exact refund approval as a project owner or admin in production.
Verify changed target and value are denied, the exact action is allowed once, and a new-request replay is denied.
Verify the runtime event, approval ledger and audit records correlate without raw arguments.
Verify monitoring, rollback and database backup status after deployment.
